metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.6 · 1969 · Tarkan
metas.description: Tarkan, a fearless and loyal warrior of Attila the Hun, enters into a bloody struggle to capture the sword of God Mars,  a weapon granting world domination to those who wield it.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.4 · 1970 · Tarkan: Gümüs Eyer
metas.description: Atilla the Hun gives a Silver Saddle to Altar as a gift. The intention of Kostok is the get rid of the Huns and seize the valuable saddle. Little Tarkan's foster mother is forced to leave him in a cave.  His cry attracts the attention of a wolf, who raises Tarkan like his own cub.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.4 · 1971 · Tarkan and the Blood of the Vikings
metas.description: The Vikings wish to kidnap a beautiful girl to sacrifice her to their demigod, but the heroic Tarkan, aided by his dog, Kurt, is there to save the day.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.3 · 1972 · Tarkan: Altin Madalyon
metas.description: Vandal king Attila's trying to save his son kidnapped by Tarkan and stories of friends.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.5 · 1973 · Tarkan and the Armless Hero
metas.description: Atilla the Hun, Tarkan its power in order to bring the sword to the floor at the pursuit of the enemy's appointed.
